title: BRIDGE: Bridging the Semantic Quantization Gap for Generative Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2611.07425v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative recommendation retrieves items by autoregressively generating Semantic IDs(SIDs), where an RQ-VAE quantizes each item into a hierarchical SID sequence that the decoder generates level by level. We identify an overlooked bottleneck in this paradigm: the Semantic Quantization Gap(SQG). Quantization derives SIDs from rich continuous signals, including codebook centroids, local neighborhood geometry, and level-wise entropy. However, the decoder receives only discrete identifiers and loses the semantic structure that shaped them. This mismatch manifests in three ways: a grounding gap, where the decoder lacks semantic anchors when target-side information is limited; a neighborhood gap, where token-level supervision discards inter-item similarity and exacerbates exposure bias; and a difficulty gap, where computation is allocated uniformly despite generation difficulty diminishing with depth.   To bridge the SQG, we propose BRIDGE. Co

translated_title: BRIDGE：弥合生成式推荐中的语义量化鸿沟
translated_abstract: 生成式推荐通过自回归地生成语义标识符（SID）来检索物品，其中RQ-VAE将每个物品量化为分层的语义ID序列，解码器逐层生成该序列。我们识别出该范式中的一个被忽视的瓶颈：语义量化鸿沟（SQG）。量化过程从丰富的连续信号中推导出语义ID，包括码本质心、局部邻域几何结构和逐层熵。然而，解码器仅接收离散标识符，丢失了塑造这些标识符的语义结构。这种不匹配体现在三个方面：一是接地鸿沟，即当目标侧信息有限时，解码器缺乏语义锚点；二是邻域鸿沟，即词元级别的监督丢弃了物品间的相似性并加剧了曝光偏差；三是难度鸿沟，即尽管生成难度随深度递减，计算资源却被均匀分配。为了弥合SQG，我们提出了BRIDGE。
tldr: 该论文揭示了生成式推荐中的一个被忽视的瓶颈——语义量化鸿沟（SQG），即解码器仅接收离散语义ID而丢失了量化过程中丰富的连续语义结构，并提出了BRIDGE方法从接地、邻域和难度三个方面弥合这一鸿沟。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies the Semantic Quantization Gap (SQG) in generative recommendation—where the decoder receives only discrete Semantic IDs and loses the rich continuous semantic signals from quantization—and proposes BRIDGE to bridge this gap across grounding, neighborhood, and difficulty aspects.
